fusions.name: Finishing Report
fusions.desc: Fires a charge of packed grit at a target up to 7 tiles away that is at or below 25% of its health; it deals 24 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Quarry Face Blast
fusions.desc: Sets off a blasting charge that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles ahead of you. Every hit is a critical hit and has a 50% chance to leave the enemy [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighted Down the Line
fusions.desc: Raises your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Bed Joint
fusions.desc: Your piercing damage ignores 12% of armour, and your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
